prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / UI production sprites.
Create a clean reusable production asset sheet for the same Chinese Daoist chibi fishing game as the attached artworks. Image 1 approved mail UI and Image 2 approved team UI define the exact art family: jade/teal, warm ivory silk-paper, fine warm gold borders, rounded ruyi/cloud forms, high-definition delicate hand-painted highlights and shading, restrained jade/metal quality. Image 3 shows the corresponding current game control or inventory design and is a fidelity reference.
This is a transparent asset sheet, not a screen mockup or presentation: no background scenery, characters, text, numbers, labels, words, headings, watermark, floor, shadow ground, checkerboard paint, cards behind the requested assets or grid lines. Genuine transparent RGBA background between assets. Each asset is isolated and complete, centered in its equal grid cell, with at least 12 percent transparent gap to every cell edge. All silhouettes remain wholly within their own cell. No item may touch or overlap adjacent cells. Keep exact row-major order. Distinct states change rendering rather than adding a word. Match the restrained polished approved source, avoid glossy plastic or photorealism. Native detail, crisp smooth alpha edges.
Canvas SQUARE, exactly SIX equal columns and SIX equal rows, 36 separate item icons. One complete distinct object per cell, occupying about 66-70% of cell dimensions, generous true-transparent gaps. No frames or inventory tiles behind icons. Strict row-major order:
ROW1: gold Chinese coin stack; round green jade crystal; three green jade crystal shards; pearly pink shell with small jade tassel; blue ice talisman scroll with snowflake emblem; purple lightning-net talisman scroll with net emblem.
ROW2: folded gold/aqua fishing net; ornate bronze key; closed jade/gold treasure chest; red silk coin pouch; ivory/gold gourd cannon with jade fittings; a compact jade/gold cannon ornament with ruyi cloud curl.
ROW3: gold sun gear auto icon; gold round target reticle; gold/cyan spiral skill icon; open ivory/jade book; ivory sealed envelope with little fish seal; rolled jade scroll.
ROW4: jade/gold medal; red/gold gift box; small jade shop bag; two jade profile silhouettes friends icon; gold laurel medal ranking icon; jade/gold settings gear.
ROW5: gold music note; gold sound speaker; small jade vibrating device with vibration marks; little jade frame containing a miniature mountain; ivory left return arrow with fine gold edge; ivory plus symbol on jade disc.
ROW6: ivory minus symbol on jade disc; bronze padlock; ivory checkmark on jade seal; single translucent aqua bubble; cyan pearl projectile with tiny short jade comet tail; luminous ivory pearl.
Maintain exact distinct objects/order, don't replace with random objects, no words or numbers in any cell. Emblems, arrows, plus/minus/check and silhouettes are pictograms, not lettering. All thirty-six independent complete icons.
